verdict.rationale: Godot is a locally run, open-source game engine and editor, not a hosted service holding production data. A sandbox-versus-production test environment is not a meaningful axis for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence describes a production-data tier, test environment or sandbox mode that would make the axis apply. Headless mode and editor scripts are local execution features, not sandbox isolation from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
